RESPONSE TO OJBECTIONS TO THE PREFILED DIRECT TESTIMONY OF SUSAN
          CORNWELL ON BEHALF OF NARUNA INTERVENORS

        TO THE HONORABLE JUDGES BRITE, QUINN AND CHICO:
        COME NOW, Naruna Investments, LLC, Scott’s Alamo, LP, Susan Cornwell and W.
Reegan Busby (Naruna Intervenors) in the above-docketed matter, and file this Response to Oncor
Electric Delivery Company, LLC and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation’s (Applicants)
Objections to, and Motion to Strike, Intervenor Testimony (hereinafter, the Objections) and would
respectfully show the following:
                                                          I.
                                                  BACKGROUND
        State Office of Administrative Hearings (SOAH) Order Nos. 6 and 9 established May 18,
2026 as the deadline for objections to intervenor direct testimony. On May 18, Applicants filed
extensive objections,1 including objections to Intervenor Susan Cornwell on behalf of Naruna

1
 Oncor Electric Delivery Company, LLC and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation’s Objections to, and
Motion to Strike, Intervenor Testimony at Exhibit A (May 18, 2026).

SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349                                                                            1
PUC Docket No. 59475
Response to Objections to Prefiled Direct Testimony
 Intervenors.2 Pursuant to Order No. 1 and title 16 Texas Administrative Code (TAC) § 22.78(a),
this Response is filed within five working days from the receipt of Applicants’ objections and is
therefore timely filed.
                                                             II.
                                                       RESPONSE
         1.       Cornwell, p. 28, lines 11 through 163
         Applicants’ hearsay objection is made to Ms. Cornwell’s direct quote from her email
correspondence with representatives of the Kempner Water Supply Corporation (KWSC) which
WSC has extensive water resource infrastructure on the Naruna Intervenors’ property.4 The
alleged objectionable statement is KWSC’s expressed concern of danger posed by the proposed
transmission line to water resources that provide drinking water to thousands of its customers.
KWSC is a governmental body within the scope of Texas Government Code ch. 552 (Texas Public
Information Act) rendering its email correspondence an exception to hearsay as a public record
under Tex. R. Evid. § 803(8).
         2.       Cornwell, p. 32, line 29 through p. 33, line 3
         Like their earlier objection, Applicants’ objection to a direct quote from Senator Pete
Flores’ May 5, 2026 letter to the Commission (SC-24 and Interchange Item No. 3664) also fails
because the Senator’s letter fits the public record exception to hearsay and the document speaks
for itself.
         3.       SC-7
         Applicants object to the aerial maps showing measured distances from the proposed
centerline to certain on-property features such as 2 trailer-mounted hunting cabins, an RV, 2 future
homesites, 3 stock tanks, 27 wildlife management infrastructure (deer blinds and feeder pens) and
the KWSC water resource facilities, presumably on the grounds of hearsay and expert


2
  Despite Susan Cornwell’s explicit statement that she was testifying on behalf of Naruna Investments, LLC, Scott’s
Alamo, LP, her daughter W. Reegan Busby and herself, individually (Ex. SC-1 at 5:6-10, 16-18), Applicants’
objections are directed only to the corporate entities. Naruna Intervenors’ response to Applicants’ List of
Intervenors Who Did Not File Testimony or a Statement of Position (May 15, 2026) (identifying W. Reegan Busby)
was filed separately on May 20, 2026 (Interchange Item No. 4789).
3
  For clarity, this filing responds in the same manner as Applicants’ citations - to the Bates-stamped page number
instead of inset page number.
4
 See SC-5(photos of storage tanks and pump station) and SC-12-14 (recordings of permanent easements in favor of
KWSC).

  qualifications. The maps are not out-of-court statements but created by or under Ms. Cornwell’s
 supervision who has personal knowledge of the structures on her property, all of which she testified
 that she uses, enjoys and maintains. Conversely, Applicants either have no knowledge of the
 features or wholly eliminated them from consideration and inclusion in the Application (and
 Environmental Assessment).
         Additionally, one does not have to be a qualified registered professional engineer to operate
 Google Earth Pro. Ms. Cornwell’s PFT provides a thorough explanation for how the distance
 information was derived since Applicants’ interactive routing and parcel map did not provide any
 end-user measurement tool.5 These measurements (and depictions on the maps) are rationally
 based on Ms. Cornwell’s perception of structures on her property and helpful to clearly
 understanding her testimony about a fact in issue.
         4.       SC-17
         See response to II.1 above.
         5.       SC-18
         The first and third (of 3) maps included in SC-18 clearly show they are KWSC documents
 which mean they are public records and exceptions to hearsay. As explained above, Ms. Cornwell
 also has personal knowledge of the structures on her property and their locations, reflected on the
 second map which is rationally based on her perception and helpful to the ALJs to determine the
 proposed distance from water resource infrastructure to the proposed centerline.
         6.       SC-22
         The 2009 article from the Lampasas Dispatch Record regarding Ms. Cornwell’s land
 stewardship is a public record and exception to hearsay.
         7.       SC-24
         See response to II.2 above.
                                                       III.
                                                   CONCLUSION
         For the reasons set out above, Naruna Intervenors request that the ALJs overrule
Applicants’ objections to their testimony in their entirety, deny the motion to strike as to their
testimony, accord Naruna Intervenors’ PFT the appropriate weight it is due and grant all other relief
to which they are entitled.

  See SC-1 at 19:22-20:9.
